description:
All levels available, from recent graduates to 10+ years of experience. We hire the right person at the right level; title and scope are set by capability.

About Karman Industries

Karman Industries is a Torrance-based thermal technology company building the backbone for giga-scale AI infrastructure. Founded by a team from SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and GE, Karman is moving beyond legacy cooling with the launch of the HPU (Heat Processing Unit), a new category of thermal architecture designed for the 100kW+ rack era.

The HPU shrinks the exterior mechanical yard by up to 80% while reducing peak energy consumption by 10%+ . Unlike traditional systems, the Karman HPU provides zero-water (WUE 0) cooling that keeps high-TDP GPUs and HBM4 memory at optimal thermal setpoints without throttling.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing team that designs, builds, and tests real hardware, and we lead with ownership: you'll own your work from concept to hardware and help shape how we scale. Our values are Ownership, Performance Excellence, Radical Transparency, and Customer-Centricity.

The role

Karman is seeking a highly motivated Embedded Software Engineer to design the next generation of heat processing systems. You will write, test, and release the embedded code that controls our energy conversion hardware, built around emerging high-voltage semiconductor technologies, and integrate it with the Karman HPU. You don't need to be a power electronics designer, but you do need to understand the physical system and the physics behind what your code controls. We rely on a first-principles approach and work as one team to deliver a cohesively developed system.

Responsibilities

• Write production embedded software for LV and MV power conversion systems

• Develop full stack embedded software including bootloader, complex IC drivers for power and communication, real-time control, protection, diagnostics, flight recorder, security, etc.

• Develop advanced digital controls, including sensing and regulation for MV power flow, grid synchronization, AC and DC voltage and current closed-loop control, motor field-oriented control

• Develop optimal PWM control strategy for wide-bandgap devices and power electronics hardware

• Define embedded software build and release processes and toolchain.

• Hands-on debug embedded software codes on target hardware systems

• Work with a tightly knit, cross-disciplinary team on every aspect of the HPU

• Bring novel solutions to hard problems and challenge the status quo

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical, software, or controls engineering, ideally with power electronics or hardware exposure

• Demonstrated experience writing embedded code that runs on real hardware, through industry, research, or significant project work

• Working knowledge of the physical system your software controls, such as power conversion, motors, or sensing

• Familiarity with SIL/HIL development methods and platforms such as Typhoon HIL, Opal-RT, or Speedgoat

• Knowledge of electrical test equipment and safe handling of high-power systems

• Self-motivated, high-performing, able to self-manage and multi-task, and an excellent communicator

Desired skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with SiC power devices and modules

• Familiarity with MV systems and grid control strategies

• Experience with electrical safety standards in the UL or IEC family

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

Karman Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Karman Industries is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Direct applicants only: we are not working with outside recruiters or agencies for this role.
